supports: deterministic Rule execution and replay integrity

dataset_limitations: The eleven frozen records are noisy secondary/tertiary pages with truncated text, duplicated parsing, retrospective claims and incompatible incident or loss figures; they are not independently reconciled history.
Draft relation and transaction endpoints conflict with actor-local identities in S1/E2, S2/E3–E5 and S4/E8. Those endpoints do not confer runtime authority.

The Draft mixes physical incidents, eligibility and investigation-subject status with participant decisions. The simulation explicitly separates passive context, representation-gate records and active intents.

Aviation restrictions, completed refunds/exchanges, device inventory, production volumes, court outcomes and recall effectiveness lack executable source participants or state mechanisms and remain outside the reducer.
The 2017 root-cause account is future information for 2016 actors. It appears only after a modeled commission, investigation and delivered findings; earlier observations contain no final-cause text.
Population records are aggregate choices, not claims that every purchaser reported, disputed, returned a device or litigated.
Full Draft exposure and authored logical-time compression preclude unbiased prediction, timing calibration, historical fit or held-out claims.
